Lightens or darkens the whole picture — nights, caves and interiors are what it is for.

Windowed (Fullscreen) fills the screen with a borderless window; Windowed runs in an ordinary one.

messages.hoa.ui.glue.fires_3_holy_bolts_at_the_en: Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you in the last 5 sec, or else the nearest enemies, each dealing Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes a Shield, up to 6% of your maximum health.

messages.hoa.ui.glue.flays_the_nearest_enemy_unti: Flays the nearest enemy until it dies

messages.hoa.ui.glue.frost_controls_and_shatters_: Frost controls and shatters, Fire burns and nukes, and Arcane blinks through the horde.

messages.hoa.ui.glue.launches_a_bolt_of_frost_at_: Launches a bolt of frost at the nearest enemy, dealing Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Chill. Deals 50% more to Frozen enemies, and your Frost spells always critically strike them.

Lightens or darkens the whole picture — nights, caves and interiors are what it is for.

This is the same correction 1.12 applied through the display's own gamma ramp, which it could only do in exclusive fullscreen. benilla applies it to the finished image instead, so it works in both display modes.
